repeated_requests._comment: Repeated requests with the same method, URL and body. Every entry must survive filter_and_compress_har, in recorder order: a repeat can differ from the first in outcome or content, and neither is ours to discard.

large_har._comment: 20 unique GET entries with large response bodies for compression testing

har_with_root_among_bloat._comment: A capture whose device root and its stored body sit among bloat entries. filter_and_compress_har removes by file extension only, so the root request and its body must survive every option combination.

har_login_posts_back._comment: A login form POSTing back to its own URL: a wrong password, then right ones answered by a tiny meta-refresh page. All three bodies are empty, as when the redirect evicts them before Playwright flushes.

har_redirect_before_login._comment: The same GET before login (meta-refresh page) and after login (full page).

har_credential_annotation_after_bloat._comment: Bloat entries ahead of the annotated login; _sanitized_credentials names entries by position, so filtering must re-point it (and drop the annotation of a removed entry).
